usedFor: Qminder holds the queue of visitors, and Freshsales Classic holds the deals that “Create Deal” opens for them.

bestTemplate.name: “visitor checks in” in Qminder, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A visitor's check-in opens a deal linked to an account, and creates the contact if it is missing.

watchOut: “Update Deal” finds a deal by ID or name, so “visitor checks in” must pass one of them.
